skill_wiring_gap_fixed_by_lead.issue: npc_skills.damage_modifier() and consume_attack_bonus() were implemented but never called from any damage path, so parry (30% for 2s) and dash slash (+2 next melee hit) had no effect
skill_wiring_gap_fixed_by_lead.fix: combat.gd now routes hostile damage through _final_hostile_damage() (consumes an NPC attacker's dash bonus and applies the target's parry/shield rate); enemy.gd order_attack() consumes the attacker's own dash bonus; npc_skills.damage_modifier() now returns only the parry/shield buff rate so equipment/general reduction is not double-applied
skill_wiring_gap_fixed_by_lead.measured: raw 3.0 -> base 3.0; with parry 2.1 (70%); dash bonus 2.0 -> NPC strike costs the player 3.0 life and the bonus is consumed

chief_heal_gap_fixed_by_lead.issue: the wood chief's recovery spell only set the branch regen buff on the caster id; enemy tribe members are not vital actors, so the chief never actually regained health while still paying 10 mana and a 20s cooldown
chief_heal_gap_fixed_by_lead.fix: npc_skills now runs its own regeneration state per enemy (1 hp every 3 online seconds for 30 seconds), persisted in export_state/restore, applied in _step()
chief_heal_gap_fixed_by_lead.measured: hp 12 -> 13 after the first tick, tick re-arms at 3.0, effect decays from 30s; verified through _step() and asserted in the acceptance probe

performance_comparison.method: same scene, same 62 enemies / 62 population members / same player position; 60 timed calls of session.tribes.advance(0.5) with the 0.10.0 domains active, then the same 60 calls with the guards and npc_skills domains removed from the advance loop; headless CPU measurement
performance_comparison.delta: +1.14 ms median per 0.5s tick (+88%) with the player far from all tribes; worst measured tick 6.14 ms stays well inside a 16.7 ms 60 FPS budget
performance_comparison.caveat: CPU-side advance cost only; no claim of a constant 60 FPS in every scene.

defects_found_and_fixed.issue: RefCounted (tribes.workers) assigned to a Node-typed local -> every patrol/life move errored, 54MB of log spam
var nav: Node = session.world.navigation, but Navigation is RefCounted; _walkable errored and treated all points as walkable
session.romance.shift_liking -> Session has no romance property; gift applied standing/quota then aborted without commit
aid_event +10 fired for attacking a neutral villager because war.provoke() set anger before the check
killed_kin used VICTIM(-30) instead of KIN_RELATIVE(-40); attacked used WITNESS(-10) instead of VICTIM(-30)
gift_bread memory event also granted AIDED(+10), stacking on the +5 affinity gift
liking() clamped to a floor of 50 so negative affinity events were invisible; relation_memory now keeps 0-100 overrides
daily gift quota never reset on a new game day (gift_day written but never read)
_actor("") fell through to a chief_id comparison and returned an arbitrary enemy; population.count inflated every tribe by one, breaking tribes_final
candidate.get("chief_id", "") used Dictionary.get on a CharacterBody2D, erroring on unknown actor and chief_id lookups

notes: The probe uses real business entries: tribes performance path for gifts, combat.hit_enemy/apply_skill_damage/hit_structure for damage and relic attacks, persistence.save_now for disk saves, and the unified Simulation clock for pause/resume.
